snippet.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion | Story Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Bring the fight to them. 💥 Experience Alien: Rogue Incursion on PS VR2 and PCVR December 19, 2024, and Meta Quest 3 in early 2025. Pre-order now to get an exclusive weapon and armor skin inspired by Alien: Romulus. https://bit.ly/AlienRI_Pre-order

When ex-Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks receives an SOS from former squadmate Benjamin Carver, she and Davis 01 head to the remote planet Purdan to investigate. Before they know it, deeply personal stakes emerge to plunge both Zula and Davis deeper into the dark heart of Purdan to expose – and escape – the deadly horrors lurking within.
